description.name: Entry
description.text: Seven single ranged attacks (0.90 each) capped at 19999, grants [Critical Damage +50%] to all allies, grants [Attach Water with Stacking], [Damage Cap +10000], [Dual Awoken Sharpshooter Mode I (Wakka)] and [Sharpshooter Resonance +5% Boost] to the user

description.name: Dual Awoken Sharpshooter Mode I (Wakka)
description.text: Sharpshooter abilities deal 5/10/15/20/30% more damage at ability rank 1/2/3/4/5, Sharpshooter abilities trigger 1 additional time, casts Dual Wither Shot after using two Sharpshooter abilities

description.name: Dual Shift
description.text: Grants [Instant ATB 1] and [Dual Awoken Sharpshooter Mode II (Wakka)], removes [Dual Awoken Sharpshooter Mode I (Wakka)]

description.name: Instant ATB 1
description.text: Increase ATB charge speed by x9999999

description.name: Dual Awoken Sharpshooter Mode II (Wakka)
description.text: Increases the damage/healing cap by 10000, Sharpshooter abilities deal 5/10/15/20/30% more damage at ability rank 1/2/3/4/5, Sharpshooter abilities trigger 1 additional time, instant cast speed for Sharpshooter abilities, grants [Deadly Strikes +10% 1] to all allies with any Attach Water after using Sharpshooter abilities

description.name: Deadly Strikes +10% 1
description.text: Critical hits deal 10% more damage (additive with the base critical coefficient and other Critical Damage statuses)

description.name: Dual Wither Shot
description.text: Four single ranged attacks (1.02 each), 100% hit rate, causes [DEF, RES and MND -70% (8s)] and [Imperil Water 10% (5s)]

description.name: Critical Damage +50%
description.text: Critical hits deal 50% more damage (additive with the base critical coefficient)

description.name: Attach Water with Stacking
description.text: Increase Attach Water Level by 1 and increase Max Attach Element Level by 2, up to Attach Water 3
